notes.title: Update 1.3.0 is here!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21110552/a0c966c2ce70e495c5c95c98da63e25b95a96a03.pngGood day everyone,

we're here to bring you an early present: you get 1GB free drive space!

We added compression support to our game engine, so all that data needs much less space on disk. After downloading, On Rusty Trails is now occupying a mere 500 megabytes. Of course, all the content is still there, it's just more tightly packed and loads up even faster!
The only downside is that this patch is much bigger than the previous ones, because you basically have to redownload the whole thing. Future updates will be back to a few megs, though.

Complete list of changes:

 Added compression for game files, which reduces disk usage from 1.7GB down to about 500MB
 Added multi-threaded asset loading, which improves loading times
 Improved controls menu, each input can now be mapped to multiple buttons or keys
 Added Xbox 360 controller prompts (from https://opengameart.org/content/free-keyboard-and-controllers-prompts-pack)
 Fixed a bug which caused controls settings not to be saved
 Fixed minor localization issues
 Steam account name and avatar are now shown in the main menu
 Updated Steamworks SDK to 1.41
 Updated libSDL to 2.0.7

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1 released!
notes.notes:
Hi folks,

there's another update live today, it fixes a few bugs that crept into the last update, as well as some more optimizations! Enjoy :)

List of changes:

Fixed a bug in the menu where different menu sections were drawn overlapping each other
Fixed a bug in the credits section where the chinese variation of the logo was displayed when a language was selected that was neither Chinese nor English
Again, fixed a bug where the game would refuse to start when Steam Cloud was disabled
OpenGL optimizations

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0 released
notes.notes:
Greetings, dear players,

Today we pushed update 1.2.0 out. We added translated text for Chinese and German, as well as a lot of optimizations. Enjoy!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21110552/a69d765b4e4bc275dc36f51a38f0e8d3fc74598e.png

List of changes:

Added localized text for Chinese (both simplified and traditional) and German
On low quality settings, the most expensive post FX are now disabled to improve frame rates on low-end graphics cards
Optimized render state management, which improves performance, especially on low-end CPUs
Optimized task management, which positively impacts performance and battery usage
Fixed a very rare crash which happened after switching to a new level
Fixed stuttering of intro video
Minor improvements to loading times
Fixed a few minor bugs detected by UBSan
Updated Steamworks SDK to 1.40


Windows only:

Windows XP is now supported


macOS only:

Enabled usage of SSSE3 CPU instructions (previously used SSE2 only). Probably no gain in performance because of this, but it can't hurt, either.


Linux only:

Removed dependency on libGL.so, all GL functions are now dynamically loaded

notes.title: Patch 1.1.3 released
notes.notes:
Hey there,

here's another patch that addresses a technical problem on older CPUs like the Core 2 Duo.

There's a change for Windows users in this update, that might break the game in some rare cases. We moved the EXE from a sub-directory to the game directory, so you can start the game from outside Steam. This wouldn't work previously, because the game couldn't find the data files when run from the sub-directory.
So if the game fails to launch, make sure the update has downloaded correctly. You may have to restart Steam so it will receive the latest configuration.
If the error persists, there are two things you should know:


If you previously copied or moved the game files to the main directory yourself, this could clash with the update. In this case, you will get an error message that says "Write error" when launching the game.
If you don't download the update, you can't run the game from Steam anymore, because it will expect the EXE to be at the new location. There will be an error message that says "Missing executable".


Let's hope for a smooth update - here goes nothing :)
